Name: Untimed Special Orders
Author: EnderTedi
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OOwROeR.png[/img]
[size=3]Untimed Special Orders is a framework that allows modders to surpass the vanilla One Month maxmimun limitation of Special Orders, allowing them to create Special Orders with no time limit.[/size]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/StDtKqU.png[/img]
[b][size=4]For Players[/size]
[/b][size=3]This mod does nothing by itself and requires another mod to use its function. Install if a mod you've downloaded requires it.[/size][b][size=4]

For Modders
[/size][/b][size=3]To remove the time limit from a Special Order add [i]"Untimed": "true"[/i] in your Special Order's CustomFields.

[i]Untimed [/i][/size][size=3]is [b]not[/b] a bool and the value can be anything, the time limit with be removed from your Special Order as long as [i]Untimed [/i][/size][size=3]is present in the CustomFields of your Special Order.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/zVOfLW3.png[/img]
[b]Source Code: [url=https://github.com/EnderTedi/Untimed-Special-Orders]GitHub[/url][/b]﻿[/size]
